risks.title: Dependence on a single refinery in Zimbabwe
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted centrally in Item 1A, with strong language ("obliged to deliver", "significant exposure"). Dependence on Fidelity Gold Refinery is structural and regulatory, increasing its severity. The trend is stable as the Zimbabwean legal framework has not changed.

risks.title: Zimbabwean export regulations
risks.score_rationale: The monetary policy change in February 2025 (30% remittance in ZiG) is presented as a major constraint. The language is alarming ("could harm", "increased risk"). This risk has been rising since 2025 and directly impacts USD cash flow.

risks.title: Increased exposure to mining taxation
risks.score_rationale: The shift to a progressive royalty regime in 2026 is clearly documented with specific thresholds. Potential impact is high if gold prices rise. The risk is new in its current form, justifying an upward trend.

risks.title: Water shortage affecting production
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned multiple times with concerning language ("drought", "possible suspension"). It is exacerbated by the semi-arid location. The trend is stable, but mitigation measures are partial.

risks.title: Instability of Zimbabwe's power grid
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described in detail with concrete examples (outages, reliance on diesel generators). The language is alarming ("severe shortages", "risk of damage"). Despite investments in solar energy, the grid remains fragile.

risks.title: Concentration of sales to refiners in Dubai
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions dependence on AEG and Stonex refiners, but without alarming language. The risk is moderate as offshore alternatives exist, but concentration limits negotiation leverage.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks related to operations
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly mentioned, the risk is implicit in digitized mining operations and financial transfers. The mining sector is an increasingly targeted industry. The absence of direct mention in the 10-K limits perceived severity.

risks.title: Regulatory pressure on due diligence
risks.score_rationale: The risk is introduced via an official 2023 warning from the U.S. Department of State. The language is strong ("illicit actors", "terrorist financing"). It is an emerging risk with major reputational impact.

ai_positioning.summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation has no mention of artificial intelligence in its financial reports or operational activities. The company operates in the traditional mining sector with no indication of AI adoption or investment.
